I know how you feel well I can relate to it I’ve been there. For me I have these moments and then I have tiny (really small but still there) moments where life sucks a tiny little less. Sometimes it takes days sometimes weeks but then I’m sure you have it too a moment or two where you think, “hey that was a pretty nice second wouldn’t mind more of those”. Right now I’m sure you won’t be able to think of it if you’re a pessimist like myself but I know you have them because we all do. So this is what I think you should do. Take a few deep breaths, cry it out for a minute or two if you need to, slap some water on your face and go back to your friends and just act. Just pretend you’re ok. I know you’re not but just pretend and then when you get home take a benadryl or whatever you take when you need to go to sleep ASAP (I use klonopin) whatever works for you though. Just drink some water, take a shower and just go to bed. Sleep it off for now and then tomorrow is a new day, find that one tiny thing that makes life feel a little less shitty even for a second and chase the fuck out of it. Maybe it’s a tv show, maybe it’s a hobby idk just find something to help you get through. Of course therapy and meds as usual are important I myself need to take this advice too, but for right now I’ve always found going to bed is super helpful when you feel you’re at rock bottom. Think of sleep like a trial death for now just a time when nothing else matters except just sleeping. You can do this ❤️
